items.name: ExprStatisticsGraph
items.summary: This object implements a directed acyclic expression graph (DAEG) that is used to compute statistics/distributions for expressions hierarchically.
items.deprecated: since 54.0.0: Part of the unused Statistics V2 framework; see https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/22071

methods.name: assign_statistics
methods.summary: This function assigns given distributions to expressions in the DAEG. The argument `assignments` associates indices of sought expressions with their corresponding new distributions.

methods.name: evaluate_statistics
methods.summary: Computes statistics/distributions for an expression via a bottom-up traversal.

methods.name: propagate_statistics
methods.signature: fn propagate_statistics(&mut self, given_stats: Distribution) -> Result<PropagationResult>
methods.summary: Runs a propagation mechanism in a top-down manner to update statistics of leaf nodes.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(expr: Arc<dyn PhysicalExpr>, schema: &Schema) -> Result<Self>

items.name: ExprStatisticsGraphNode
items.summary: This is a node in the DAEG; it encapsulates a reference to the actual [`PhysicalExpr`] as well as its statistics/distribution.
items.deprecated: since 54.0.0: Part of the unused Statistics V2 framework; see https://github.com/apache/datafusion/pull/22071

methods.name: distribution
methods.summary: Get the [`Distribution`] object representing the statistics of the expression.

methods.name: make_node
methods.summary: This function creates a DAEG node from DataFusion's [`ExprTreeNode`] object. Literals are created with `Uniform` distributions with a definite, singleton interval. Expressions with a `Boolean` data type result in a`Bernoulli` distribution…
